correctness.rationale: Squarefreeness iff a²+1≠0 follows from f′=x³(3x⁴+4a). Tame Kummer Riemann–Hurwitz gives genera 7 and 3; x²=t branches at 3 points over zero and one over infinity. The full seven-dimensional holomorphic differential basis and fifth-root semilinear Cartier matrix are independently reconstructed from f³/f coefficients. Its invariant quotient rank is 2, anti-invariant one-step rank 2, stable rank 0 exactly at H=1+3a^6=0 and 2 elsewhere. Prime-to-five degree of Jac(D)×P→Jac(C) preserves p-divisible groups, ranks and a-numbers. H has six distinct smooth roots. Exact finite GF25 verifier reproduces all 23 smooth parameters; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: A natural µ4-symmetric deformation of the high-automorphism Kummer curve yields a geometrically motivated four-branched Prym fourfold with an exact rank-zero locus. The six-point stable-rank jump occurs although Cartier one-step rank (and a-number 2) is constant on the Prym, providing a genuine arithmetic stratification invisible to first-order Cartier rank. The full classification of smooth marked parameters and quotient/Prym decomposition is more than a routine specialization of a known p-rank table.
